# ESPN

> ESPN provides live scores, news, highlights, analysis, schedules, standings, fantasy games, and streaming access for major sports worldwide.

ESPN covers professional and college sports with dedicated league hubs, real-time game information, editorial reporting, video highlights, fantasy products, and ESPN+ streaming. Its site is organized around sport-specific sections, scoreboards, teams, athletes, and event coverage.

## Core Coverage
- [ESPN Home](https://www.espn.com/): Main entry point for scores, headlines, highlights, and featured sports coverage.
- [Scores](https://www.espn.com/scoreboard): Live and upcoming game scores across major sports and leagues.
- [Watch](https://www.espn.com/watch/): Streaming hub for live events, replays, originals, and ESPN+ programming.
- [Schedule](https://www.espn.com/schedule): Daily sports schedule for televised and streamed events.
- [Standings](https://www.espn.com/standings): League and conference standings across professional and college sports.
- [Teams](https://www.espn.com/espn/teams): Directory of teams with links to club-specific coverage pages.
- [Fantasy](https://www.espn.com/fantasy/): Portal for ESPN fantasy football, basketball, baseball, and more.
- [Betting](https://www.espn.com/espn/betting/): Sports betting news, odds coverage, picks, and analysis.

## NFL
- [NFL](https://www.espn.com/nfl/): NFL news, scores, schedules, standings, stats, and analysis.
- [NFL Scoreboard](https://www.espn.com/nfl/scoreboard): Live NFL game scores, status, and matchup details.
- [NFL Schedule](https://www.espn.com/nfl/schedule): Full NFL schedule with dates, times, and broadcast information.
- [NFL Standings](https://www.espn.com/nfl/standings): Division and conference standings for the NFL season.
- [NFL Teams](https://www.espn.com/nfl/teams): Directory of NFL team pages and club coverage.
- [NFL Draft](https://www.espn.com/nfl/draft): Draft rankings, mock drafts, prospect analysis, and results.
- [NFL Stats](https://www.espn.com/nfl/stats): League leaders and statistical categories for NFL players and teams.

## NBA
- [NBA](https://www.espn.com/nba/): NBA news, scores, standings, schedules, and expert coverage.
- [NBA Scoreboard](https://www.espn.com/nba/scoreboard): Live NBA scores, game states, and matchup summaries.
- [NBA Schedule](https://www.espn.com/nba/schedule): Complete NBA schedule with dates and tipoff times.
- [NBA Standings](https://www.espn.com/nba/standings): Conference standings and playoff race tracking.
- [NBA Teams](https://www.espn.com/nba/teams): Directory of NBA team pages and roster coverage.
- [NBA Stats](https://www.espn.com/nba/stats): Player and team statistical leaders across NBA categories.
- [NBA Draft](https://www.espn.com/nba/draft): Draft news, rankings, mock drafts, and prospect coverage.

## MLB
- [MLB](https://www.espn.com/mlb/): MLB news, scores, schedules, standings, and baseball analysis.
- [MLB Scoreboard](https://www.espn.com/mlb/scoreboard): Live MLB scores, inning status, and game details.
- [MLB Schedule](https://www.espn.com/mlb/schedule): Full baseball schedule with daily and seasonal listings.
- [MLB Standings](https://www.espn.com/mlb/standings): Division standings, records, and playoff positioning.
- [MLB Teams](https://www.espn.com/mlb/teams): Directory of MLB team pages and club coverage.
- [MLB Stats](https://www.espn.com/mlb/stats): Batting, pitching, and team statistical leaders.
- [MLB Transactions](https://www.espn.com/mlb/transactions): Recent roster moves, signings, and player transactions.

## NHL
- [NHL](https://www.espn.com/nhl/): NHL news, scores, standings, schedules, and hockey coverage.
- [NHL Scoreboard](https://www.espn.com/nhl/scoreboard): Live NHL scores, periods, and matchup details.
- [NHL Schedule](https://www.espn.com/nhl/schedule): Full NHL schedule with game dates and times.
- [NHL Standings](https://www.espn.com/nhl/standings): Division, conference, and league standings.
- [NHL Teams](https://www.espn.com/nhl/teams): Directory of NHL team pages and roster coverage.
- [NHL Stats](https://www.espn.com/nhl/stats): Skating, goalie, and team statistical leaders.
- [NHL Transactions](https://www.espn.com/nhl/transactions): Recent trades, recalls, and roster transactions.

## College Sports
- [Men's College Basketball](https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/): NCAA men's basketball news, scores, rankings, and tournament coverage.
- [Men's College Basketball Scoreboard](https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/scoreboard): Live scores and game status for men's college basketball.
- [Men's College Basketball Rankings](https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/rankings): Polls and rankings for NCAA men's basketball teams.
- [Women's College Basketball](https://www.espn.com/womens-college-basketball/): NCAA women's basketball news, scores, rankings, and analysis.
- [College Football](https://www.espn.com/college-football/): College football news, scores, rankings, and bowl coverage.
- [College Football Scoreboard](https://www.espn.com/college-football/scoreboard): Live college football scores and game details.
- [College Football Rankings](https://www.espn.com/college-football/rankings): AP, Coaches, and playoff rankings coverage.
- [NCAA Recruiting](https://www.espn.com/college-sports/recruiting/): Recruiting rankings, commitments, and prospect analysis.

## Soccer, Tennis, Golf, and More
- [Soccer](https://www.espn.com/soccer/): Global soccer news, scores, tables, fixtures, and transfer coverage.
- [Tennis](https://www.espn.com/tennis/): Tennis news, scores, rankings, and tournament coverage.
- [Golf](https://www.espn.com/golf/): Golf news, leaderboards, results, and major championship coverage.
- [MMA](https://www.espn.com/mma/): MMA and UFC news, fight cards, rankings, and results.
- [Boxing](https://www.espn.com/boxing/): Boxing news, fight schedules, rankings, and results.
- [WNBA](https://www.espn.com/wnba/): WNBA news, scores, standings, and player coverage.
- [NASCAR](https://www.espn.com/racing/nascar/): NASCAR news, schedules, standings, and race coverage.
- [F1](https://www.espn.com/f1/): Formula 1 news, race schedules, standings, and analysis.

## Fantasy Sports
- [Fantasy Home](https://www.espn.com/fantasy/): Central hub for ESPN fantasy games, news, and tools.
- [Fantasy Football](https://fantasy.espn.com/football/): Fantasy football game, league management, and player tools.
- [Fantasy Basketball](https://fantasy.espn.com/basketball/): Fantasy basketball game, league setup, and roster management.
- [Fantasy Baseball](https://fantasy.espn.com/baseball/): Fantasy baseball game, league tools, and player management.
- [Fantasy Hockey](https://fantasy.espn.com/hockey/): Fantasy hockey game, league setup, and roster tools.
- [Fantasy Women's Basketball](https://fantasy.espn.com/womens-basketball/): Fantasy women's basketball leagues and gameplay tools.
- [Fantasy Games Home](https://fantasy.espn.com/): Entry point for ESPN fantasy products and account access.

## Streaming and Video
- [ESPN Watch](https://www.espn.com/watch/): Live streams, replays, clips, and ESPN+ content library.
- [ESPN+](https://www.espn.com/espnplus/): Information and featured programming for ESPN's subscription streaming service.
- [Daily Schedule](https://www.espn.com/schedule): Daily listing of upcoming televised and streamed sports events.
- [30 for 30](https://www.espn.com/watch/series/30-for-30): Documentary series hub with episodes and related programming.
- [Originals](https://www.espn.com/watch/catalog/252c90a9-a4c9-39f7-a4f7-0e502e9f8f3f): ESPN original shows and on-demand programming.
- [Live Now](https://www.espn.com/watch/schedule/_/type/upcoming): Upcoming and live streaming event schedule.

## News, Analysis, and Tools
- [ESPN News Services](https://www.espn.com/espn/news/story?page=NewsServices): Aggregated wire and ESPN news service stories.
- [Odds](https://www.espn.com/espn/lines): Sports odds, lines, and matchup betting information.
- [Daily Wager](https://www.espn.com/chalk/): Betting-focused analysis, picks, and sportsbook coverage.
- [Injuries](https://www.espn.com/injuries): Cross-sport injury report listings and player status updates.
- [Search](https://www.espn.com/search): Site search for teams, players, leagues, and articles.
- [The ESPN Daily Podcast](https://www.espn.com/radio/play/_/id/28264029): Daily sports podcast featuring reporting and analysis.
- [Where to Watch Sports on TV and Streaming](https://www.espn.com/where-to-watch): Viewing guide for sports across TV networks and streaming services.
